title: Final Answer for (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and present d ln p/dT = l/RT^2.

title: Final Answer for (b)(i)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and present u = tau - T (d tau/dT).

title: Final Answer for (b)(ii)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly conclude that (dT/dA)_{adia} > 0.

title: Key Reasoning for (a)
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the Carnot cycle and the relationships between Q, W, and dW.

title: Key Reasoning for (b)(i)
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the derivation of the relationship between surface energy density and surface tension.

title: Common Errors in (a)
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes or incorrect application of the ideal gas law.

title: Common Errors in (b)(i)
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid errors in the derivation of u and tau, particularly in the signs of terms.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the derivations.

title: Limiting Cases Discussion
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss limiting cases or implications of the results derived.
